service_boundary: Represents the AI/ML API reselling service, not the labs whose models it forwards to.
regional_controls: No customer control over processing geography is documented.
retention_controls: The privacy policy states no retention period beyond keeping data as long as necessary, and no position on training over customer prompts is documented.
routing: Requests reach a named model through one compatible endpoint; provider selection, fallback, and steering controls are not documented.
customization: No customer fine-tuning or private deployment is documented.
strengths: A single compatible endpoint reaches an unusually broad multimodal catalogue spanning text, image, video, and voice vendors.
Response headers report spend per request, making cost attribution possible without a separate metering system.
tradeoffs: Per-token rates are the operator's own and sit consistently above the rates other aggregators publish for the same models, with no statement anywhere of how they relate to upstream pricing.
The terms promise to carry a last-updated date and carry none, and no position on training over customer prompts is stated.
Subscription tiers and the paused free tier are visible only after signing in.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the upstream model appears in the request-tracing documentation or elsewhere in the API reference.
response_integrity.scope: AI/ML API request-tracing documentation, for the AI/ML API

upstream_disclosure.note: The model database names each model's developer, such as "Open AI" for gpt-3.5-turbo and "Alibaba Cloud" for alibaba/qwen-plus, but no page names which parties receive request content or whether models are served by the developer, by AI/ML API, or by another host; the privacy policy is a website-visitor notice.
upstream_disclosure.scope: AI/ML API model database, for the AI/ML API

credential_handling.note: The documentation offers no customer-supplied-key path: the API-key guide states "API keys are used to call our models from the Playground and from your own applications via the API." and every documented request authenticates with an AI/ML API key.
credential_handling.scope: AI/ML API key guide, for the AI/ML API

cache_isolation.note: No prompt-caching feature is documented, and the privacy policy does not mention caching.
cache_isolation.scope: AI/ML API privacy policy, for the AI/ML API

vulnerability_disclosure.note: Neither the terms and conditions nor the privacy policy names a security contact or disclosure route, and no security.txt is served.
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: AI/ML API terms and conditions, for the AI/ML API

independent_audit.note: The enterprise page says only: "We prioritise the security and privacy of your data with robust top level security measures, ensuring your data is fully protected with thorough encryption and strict compliance protocols." No certification is named.
independent_audit.scope: AI/ML API enterprise page, for the AI/ML API
